groups.name: xarch.resilience
groups.description: Master switch and nested groups for the xarch resilience starter.

groups.name: xarch.resilience.rate-limit
groups.description: Token-bucket rate limit defaults used by the global filter and @RateLimit.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for the resilience starter.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.rate-limit.servlet-enabled
properties.description: Whether the global rate-limit servlet filter is registered.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.rate-limit.permits-per-second
properties.description: Default permits per second granted to each bucket.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.rate-limit.burst-capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of tokens the bucket can hold during an idle burst.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.rate-limit.default-scope
properties.description: Bucket key strategy for the global filter.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.rate-limit.timeout-millis
properties.description: Maximum wait time (ms) for a permit. 0 means fail fast.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.rate-limit.redis-key-prefix
properties.description: Redis key prefix used for the bucket hash.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.circuit-breaker.failure-rate-threshold
properties.description: Failure rate (percentage) above which the breaker opens.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.circuit-breaker.sliding-window-size
properties.description: Sliding window size used to evaluate the failure rate.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.circuit-breaker.minimum-number-of-calls
properties.description: Minimum number of calls required before the breaker can trip.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.circuit-breaker.wait-duration-in-open-state-millis
properties.description: Time the breaker stays open before transitioning to half-open.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.circuit-breaker.permitted-number-of-calls-in-half-open-state
properties.description: Permitted calls in the half-open state to probe recovery.

properties.name: xarch.resilience.bulkhead.max-wait-duration-millis
properties.description: Maximum wait time (ms) when the bulkhead is full.
